description: Données Ouvertes sur les Énergies Renouvelables, Combustibles et Déchets (% de l'Énergie Totale) au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Banque Mondiale. Les énergies renouvelables combustibles et les déchets comprennent la biomasse solide, la biomasse liquide, le biogaz, les déchets industriels et les déchets municipaux, mesurés en pourcentage de la consommation totale d’énergie. Lien vers la source:cliquez ici. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Banque Mondiale. Its tags are combustibles-et-dechets, energies-renouvelables. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
